description: The Government of Odisha has taken a major step toward building sovereign, population-scale artificial intelligence systems by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Sarvam AI to establish a Sovereign AI Capacity Hub in the state.
body_lead: The Government of Odisha has taken a major step toward building sovereign, population-scale artificial intelligence systems by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Sarvam AI to establish a Sovereign AI Capacity Hub in the state. The initiative marks a strategic shift from focusing solely on large AI models to creating real-world, deployable AI systems designed for governance, industry, and citizens at scale.
